subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 official action updates be accepted together after a fresh rebase and exact-head credentialed-workflow validation?
rationale: The patch changes executable supply-chain code used with repository tokens and secrets; repository policy requires explicit owner review even though the pins are official and no concrete malicious or incorrect change was found.

options.title: Rebase and validate together
options.body: Refresh all pins on current main and accept the group only after the security, release, CodeQL, and Codex workflow gates complete successfully.

options.title: Split privileged action updates
options.body: Separate token, registry-login, and Codex action changes from lower-risk setup and maintenance actions for narrower review and rollback.

recommendation.title: Rebase and validate together
recommendation.body: Refresh all pins on current main and accept the group only after the security, release, CodeQL, and Codex workflow gates complete successfully.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to the central CI and release workflows affected by the update.
